fields: as a table: cols [standard, what we design to, proof, where we show it], rows (cells strings or {t, link}), fold, fold_noun.
best_for: PipeCollage sets an evidence table as a Swiss poster: a geometric collage of flat pieces, one numbered piece per standard (a pressure vessel, a control panel, a flanged elbow, resin pellets, a fused joint) among plain filler tiles, beside the rows as asymmetric editorial blocks hung from hairline brackets.
